map.消防设施维保按 5 项（灭火器、消火栓、报警系统、喷淋系统、应急照明与疏散指示）: Fire facility maintenance is evaluated item by item across 5 items (extinguishers, hydrants, alarm system, sprinkler system, emergency lighting and evacuation signage), with 1 point counted per problem; a maintenance period exceeding 3 months without inspection adds 2 points; a total of 0 means maintenance passes, 1 to 2 points is a minor defect, and 3 points or more requires rectification within a deadline; the statutory periods are extinguishers inspected once a year, hydrants inspected quarterly, and the alarm and sprinkler systems patrolled monthly with a full inspection once a year.
map.消防设施维保评估（5项维保质量检测）: Fire facility maintenance assessment (5-item maintenance quality detection)
map.消防设施维保评定中，按灭火器、消火栓、报警、喷淋、应急照明逐项评分，并结合维保周: In fire facility maintenance assessment, extinguishers, hydrants, alarm, sprinklers and emergency lighting are scored item by item, combined with the maintenance period.
map.维保单位季度/年度评估时，用评分量化合格、基本合格与不合格。: During quarterly/annual assessment by the maintenance unit, the scoring quantifies pass, basically pass and fail.
map.维保周期过长会额外扣分，倒逼缩短巡检间隔。: An overly long maintenance period deducts extra points, pushing the inspection interval shorter.
map.算例：全部合格、周期 2 个月: Worked example: all pass, period 2 months
map.维保评分 = 0 / 17 → 『维保合格』，建议保持当前 2 个月维保周期。: Maintenance score = 0 / 17 -> 'maintenance passes'; recommended to keep the current 2-month maintenance period.
map.算例：周期 4 个月触发加扣: Worked example: a 4-month period triggers the extra deduction
map.若各项 0 分但周期 >3 个月，总分额外 +2 = 2 ≤ 4 → 『基本合格: If all items score 0 but the period is >3 months, the total gets +2 = 2 <= 4 -> 'basically passes', with the note 'maintenance period too long (4 months)', and shortening it to 1-2 months is recommended.
map.维保周期为什么会影响评分？: Why does the maintenance period affect the score?
map.周期过长意味着隐患暴露窗口拉长，本工具对周期 >3 个月额外加扣 2 分，以促使: A long period means the exposure window for hidden hazards grows; this tool deducts an extra 2 points for a period >3 months, to encourage shorter inspection intervals, in line with the maintenance principle of 'prevention first'.
map.基本合格和不合格怎么界定？: How are basically pass and fail defined?
map.本工具约定总分 0 为维保合格、≤4 为基本合格、>4 为维保不合格（满分 17: This tool uses a total of 0 for maintenance pass, <=4 for basically pass, and >4 for maintenance fail (17 in total, 0 = all pass). A fail requires immediate full overhaul and stronger patrolling.
